card.name: Digits inside UK helpline numbers
card.fires_on: Digits within UK freephone numbers such as 0800 1111 or 0808 800 5000 in child-abuse advice text. It also fires weakly on digits in other reference numbers.

modes.label: Helpline digits
modes.description: Digits inside a UK child-protection helpline number, such as 0800 1111 or 0808 800 5000.

modes.label: Other reference numbers
modes.description: Digits or a full stop inside citation page ranges, DOIs or international phone numbers.

card.writes: It pushes toward UK-flavoured text (pound sign, UK, Brexit, whilst) and away from Chinese place names and other cities.
card.plain: It lights up on the digits of UK helpline phone numbers, signalling British-style text is coming.
